svg.title: How option-flow gains accumulated for each stock
svg.desc: Six stock panels compare saved cumulative daily forecast-loss differences for linear and tree models. All panels use the same scale and 419 historical sessions. Positive favors adding option flow. Curves are descriptive and are not trading returns.
svg.text: How option-flow gains accumulated for each stock
Cumulative QLIKE difference: option state − (option state + flow) · 15-minute forecasts
Above zero: adding flow lowered forecast loss
Same vertical scale in every panel · 419 sessions · six stocks · all saved dates retained
Existing aggregates rounded to six decimals. A stock curve is not an independent replication.
These are cumulative forecast-loss differences, not returns, profits or an equity curve.
